comment: ANCHOR: BACKFILL_DOCUMENT_MENTIONS_TXN_1576_20261109 — the backfill's read transaction may not
span its own extraction loop. Role trade_ai ends an idle-in-transaction session after 120 s; the
2026-11-09 08:25 and 09:25 ET slots opened a session and were terminated ~121 s later because the
batch SELECT's transaction stayed open while the loop extracted documents it could not decide (no
write, so no commit). run() now commits the read transaction before the loop; persist() keeps its
per-document transaction. Hermetic fake connection enforces the server rule; synthetic rows only.
